transcript:
Header: 2026-04-30 16:00 UTC | Duration: 62 mins | Attendees: Morgan Lee (CEO), Ava Patel (CTO), Diego Ramos (VP Eng), Priya Shah (Head of Product), Lena Ortiz (Head of People), All Staff

Summary: Morgan opens with high level Q1 recap, then leadership rotates through product, engineering, security, and people updates. Q&A at the end, several customer-facing follow ups and internal action items.

[00:00] Morgan Lee: Hey everyone, uh thanks for joining. Happy to see so many faces on a Friday, we'll keep this to about an hour. Quick agenda, Q1 metrics, product, infra, security, hiring, then Q&A.

[00:32] Morgan Lee: First thing, big thank you to the teams, we hit our top-line ARR target for Q1, not quite the stretch but solid momentum. Retention's holding at 87% and usage growth on hosted API was up 24% month-over-month, so good signs.

[01:08] Ava Patel: Yeah and just to add, API latency P50 improved by ~15ms after the recent kernel changes, and the batching work is helping cost-per-token down about 8% on average workloads, though tail latency still needs work.

[01:47] Diego Ramos: The tail's one of the things we'll dig into, we did have an incident two weeks ago from a poorly sized customer burst that exposed a routing gap. We've got a post-mortem up, basically the fallback policy didn't trigger fast enough when the Dedicated pool filled, so there was a 20 minute window of elevated latencies.

[02:22] Priya Shah: On product, roadmap check: the Redwood API schema changes are staged, we're rolling out structured tool-calls and better function/schema validation next week in beta. Private/VPC customers who've signed the NDA will get access to the beta by the end of May.

[02:51] Morgan Lee: Question for folks  any blockers from sales on the beta?

[03:05] (pause)

[03:12] Diego Ramos: From infra side, we need one more ops on-call rotation for Dedicated to improve bleed-through handling. Recruiters are working that.

[03:38] Lena Ortiz: Hiring update: we closed 6 IC roles this quarter, ramping interview loops for two senior infra hires. We'll share the Q2 hiring priorities doc after this call. We're shifting one headcount from backend to infra to support Dedicated.

[04:10] Ava Patel: Back to the incident, the mitigation is twofold: change the routing policy to prefer fast-fallback to compatible model variants, and tweak autoscale thresholds for Dedicated. Diego's team will run a canary next week.

[04:47] Diego Ramos: Yep, canary scheduled Tues, we expect to measure 95th p99 latency under simulated bursts. We'll publish results in the incident doc.

[05:18] Priya Shah: On the product front there's also the Optimize toolkit improvements—batching suggestions and quantization profiles. We have case studies showing 30% cost improvements for a particular e-comm workload. We'll post a short writeup.

[05:50] Morgan Lee: Security update, Ava?

[05:55] Ava Patel: SOC 2 work is progressing. Control testing is 85% done, evidence collection pace is steady; we have a few gaps in key management evidence for Private customers. We're integrating KMS/HSM hooks in the private control plane this sprint.

[06:22] (murmur) Speaker 1: Is that going to affect our on-prem customers?

[06:28] Ava Patel: There may be additional steps for air-gapped installs, planning to include a compliance appendix for the Private deployment package. We'll surface that to Solutions.

[06:45] Morgan Lee: On sales and GTM  we're seeing inbound from AI-native startups and some enterprise trials. Key ask from buyers is predictable latency and an easier way to benchmark, so we should emphasize our Dedicated and canary benchmarking in collateral.

[07:10] Priya Shah: We'll update the docs with a dedicated benchmark spreadsheet and a short video walkthrough. Link will be in the roadmap deck.

[07:28] Morgan Lee: Quick numbers on churn  churn's trending down but engagement variance at the customer segment level suggests we need better onboarding for mid-market. Solutions is working a templated onboarding flow.

[07:55] Lena Ortiz: People update  we're launching a manager training series in May focused on hiring, inclusive interviewing, and scaling teams. Also a reminder to nominate colleagues for impact awards.

[08:18] (long pause)

[08:25] Morgan Lee: We'll do a quick lightning demo  Priya, take it away on the new function-calling schema.

[08:31] Priya Shah: Thanks. So, function-calling v2 allows structured outputs and validation at the server level. Example: a customer can declare an order schema, Redwood will validate responses and raise a structured error instead of free text. This reduces post-processing and helps safety.

[09:05] (typing, minor noise)

[09:12] Diego Ramos: One note, in the demo the KV cache was referred to as 'K V cache' in some docs, please fix that. We also need clearer guidance on cache invalidation semantics for Private deployments.

[09:34] Priya Shah: Good catch, Diego, we'll update docs.

[09:42] Morgan Lee: Alright open Q&A  drop questions in chat or raise hand.

[09:49] Staff Question (Speaker 2): Any update on pricing options for Dedicated? Customers ask about burst capacity pricing.

[10:02] Priya Shah: We're piloting a burst credit model where reserved capacity covers baseline and burst is billed separately at a premium; finance is modeling options and we'll share proposals next week.

[10:25] Staff Question (Speaker 3): Is there a timeline for on-prem support for regulated customers?

[10:33] Ava Patel: Private on-prem package is targeted for Q3 GA but we'll start closed pilot in late Q2 with two customers. Security wants to run an audit in the pilot, so timeline depends on evidence collection.

[11:00] Morgan Lee: Quick shout for cross-team syncs  Solutions and Product should meet with Security before the pilot starts.

[11:10] Diego Ramos: Ops note  please avoid heavy stress tests on staging without coordination, last week caused some CI flakes.

[11:25] (light laughter)

[11:30] Morgan Lee: Okay, we'll do a short recap  next steps: Priya blog + roadmap, Ava share SLO post-mortem and SOC2 tracker, Diego publish canary results, Lena post hiring plan. Anything else?

[11:50] (silence)

[11:55] Morgan Lee: Thanks everyone. The recording and slides will be in the notes link. End of call.

[12:02] (meeting ends)

Notes: Transcript contains a few transcription artifacts (e.g. 'K V cache' for 'KV cache', product names occasionally hyphenated or slightly off). Several references to internal docs and decks; links provided in notes_links.
